details.detail: Planform, raked tip and cruise bending. Still verified seat for seat: the 11A inlet sits 11.6 deg forward of the beam (photo about 11.5), and the 26K tip sits 5.0 deg above horizontal (photo about 4.7).
JA795A registration: unchanged since w3, and still a near one-to-one match to _7345 from 26K.

Canoes. The count and positions are right. The tails now end in a small rounded nose instead of a needle (k_canoe_side), which matches _7331/_7329. Tone: the K side flank is #cbcfd1 against a #b6bcc2 wing, and the A side is dark, as in both photos.
Gear stripe, skin seams, fastener rows at 12 %/62 % chord, panel tone, static dischargers and the flush nav light. All read right and none alias at 20-30 m.

Strake. It is now cowl-coloured with the seam inside the footprint, and it reads through its shadow line as in B-KQZ_074140 and Leaving_Sri_Lanka. It sits at the right station, 1.8-3.1 m, ahead of the aft split.

Pylon hump. The shape matches lalf_137. On the A side it renders #bec8d2 against the cowl flank at #8294ae. This is lighter than the photo (hump about equal to the cowl), but it is plausible for an up-facing surface under a bright sky.

GE90 cowl tone. On the A (shade) side it is #8294ae-#7889a2 at 13A and #8597b0-#94a1b2 at 11A. That is inside the ANA 11A range (#818c9e-#8695a4) to B-KQZ (#a9c0ce), with a slightly bluer cast (b-r about 0x2c against about 0x1d). The K (sun) side still clips: #dfe4e7-#e0e6e8 across d_13K/d_11K, with the hump (#dee3e6) merged into the cowl. The s_13A sunset cowl is still near white. This is exposure headroom, filed with lighting as from_exterior.md item 6.
Day sky (owner: lighting). Unchanged: pale #bdccdc against #527dc2 in _7282.
Sunset (owner: lighting). The shade-side wing is right. The sun-side cowl and canoes glow and clip.
Night (owner: lighting). A dark silhouette with the nav light; the beacon is still pending.
